KNOX_EVOLVED_NE_M_AntiMutantDrug_Tooltip: A powerful drug that reduces internal mutation by 40-60%. Causes severe damage and dizziness upon consumption.
KNOX_EVOLVED_NE_M_Retardant_Tooltip: Completely stops mutation accumulation from environmental contamination for a set period.
KNOX_EVOLVED_NE_DeconSpray_Tooltip: Sprays bleach in a cone to purify floors and clothing. Essential for base maintenance.
KNOX_EVOLVED_NE_DeconGrenade_Tooltip: Instantly neutralizes wide-area contamination upon explosion. For emergency escape.
KNOX_EVOLVED_NE_HomemadeSanitizer_Toolti: A sanitizer refined from agricultural alcohol. Lower duration and purification capacity compared to bleach.
KNOX_EVOLVED_NE_GasMask_Tooltip: A protective mask with a specialized filter. Protects the lungs from the contaminated atmosphere.
KNOX_EVOLVED_NE_HazmatSuit_Tooltip: A full protective suit adjusted for test subjects. Protects the whole body from the virus.
KNOX_EVOLVED_NE_FilterReload_Tooltip: Restores gas mask filter life to 100% (Reload).
KNOX_EVOLVED.NE_QuestReport: A Final Letter to You: The Truth and NOX:EVOLVED
KNOX_EVOLVED_NE_Nucleus_Tooltip: A core of mutation that emits intense viral contamination. It acts as an epicenter itself. Recovered from the lab by Dr. Hiro and sealed in a containment vial.
